name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: To achieve our goal of creating visually stunning AI website/product designs, I propose we start by gathering inspiration from Eitan's picks and creating a mood board. This will allow us to distill the essence of the desired look and feel, and make informed design decisions. By doing so, we're accepting the trade-off of spending more time on research and planning, but this will ultimately save us from potential redesigns down the line and ensure a cohesive visual identity. This approach will also enable us to make intentional design choices that align with our quality-first principle.

name: Squint
text: I'm not convinced that a mood board is the best use of our time, as it may lead to a superficial understanding of the design elements without considering the underlying functionality and user experience. A more effective approach might be to conduct a thorough analysis of Eitan's picks, identifying the specific design principles and patterns that make them successful, and then applying those insights to our own design process. To settle this, I'd like to see a comparison of the outcomes of both approaches, with a clear evaluation of which one results in a more cohesive and effective design.
